jobs.description:

Full-Time

Greater Toronto Area, ON (Hybrid)

New Role

About the Opportunity

This newly created VP, Finance & Operations role reporting directly to the Founder & CEO. You’ll own profitability, cash, the people function, legal and risk, and the operating plan the company runs against.
You’ll have a direct line to the founder, clearly defined decision rights, and room to shape the team beneath you.

Key Responsibilities

Finance & Profitability

Lead the finance function and build the team beneath you, delivering a close, reporting and controls the leadership team trusts, along with statutory compliance and tax remittances
Manage gross and contribution margin by service line, client and team, inside a pricing and margin framework you design, with rate cards, discount thresholds and a floor below which work is declined
Find and close margin leakage, and make numbers-backed recommendations on where to invest, what to reprice and what to stop
Own cash and working capital, including a rolling cash forecast reliable enough for hiring and investment decisions, DSO, collections, client credit terms and banking relationships
Work with the technology and data lead to move finance reporting toward real time, automate manual processes and choose the long-term finance tools

Planning & Strategy Execution

Turn the CEO’s strategy into a rolling 24-month operating plan with owners, dates and resourcing
Design and own the company scorecard and KPI framework, in the format you propose
Catch deviations early and build recovery plans directly with business leaders, so issues reach the CEO already diagnosed
Build the business cases and resourcing models for new hires, new functions and new service lines

Legal, Compliance & Risk

Oversee legal and compliance with external counsel, including client, vendor and employment agreements, privacy obligations and disputes
Own the insurance program and a live enterprise risk register

People & Culture

Lead people and culture through a senior People & Culture lead, building a development path that gets new hires productive faster and a defined way to identify and keep top performers
Make role clarity standard across the firm, so every role has defined outcomes, decision rights and escalation triggers

Office of the CEO

Run the leadership team’s weekly, monthly and quarterly operating rhythm, with decisions logged and every action owned
Present results to the firm and act as the CEO’s thinking partner, with written recommendations and constructive challenge

What You Bring

10+ years of progressive finance experience, including 5+ as head of finance with ownership of operations, and a degree in accounting, commerce or business
A finance and operations function you built rather than inherited, ideally while the business was changing how it delivers or who it sells to
Experience as a planning partner to a CEO or owner, including disagreeing constructively and defending your recommendations with data
A track record of moving margin, not just reporting it, with results you can quantify
Cash and working capital management across more than one revenue model, including a cash forecast that leaders rely on
People leadership in a headcount-driven business, including owning HR or acting as its business partner
Oversight of contracts and risk in a company without in-house counsel
Hands-on use of AI tools or automated workflows to solve business problems
Working command of Canadian statutory requirements, including CRA, GST/HST and Ontario employment standards

Nice to Have

CPA designation
Experience in a founder-led or owner-managed company, after time inside a larger organization
A professional services or SaaS background
Organization design experience

Next Steps

We do appreciate all interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Managing Director Corporate Finance Technology  Innovation Banking Commercial Banking
Director, Strategy
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

This role establishes a strong link between Role Design, Technology partners, and Personal and Commercial Banking partners to enable the optimization, development, and delivery of digital tools and applications used by Canadian Banking advisors.

Primary Focus

Drive horizontal strategy across all CRM and Branch Platforms to ensure integrated and consistent advisor experiences
Work across LOBs, including Personal Bank, Commercial and Private Banking on defining strategic vision and transformational roadmap for next generation of use cases and capabilities
Establishing the rigor for the ongoing management and evolution of the platform and realization of business benefits.
Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate risks, developing contingency plans and ensure effective risk management across the portfolio.
Manage budgets and financial planning in collaboration with finance and business management teams.
Track approved funding spend, forecast future needs, and ensure cost efficiency across the delivery portfolio.
Define and track product OKRs and KPIs, and drive the team to achieve them
Ensure incremental adoption of relevant Client360 capabilities and further introduction of capabilities contained within Salesforce Financial Services Cloud®
Staying up to date with the FSC products roadmap
Advocate on behalf of the advisor community in the development of enterprise tools further contributing to Advisor efficiency and experience
Driving collaboration with key internal functional partners
Responsible for strategic alignment across major, Big Rock/large initiatives and digitization with Client360 Platform.
Ensure technology roadmaps align with advisor needs, RBC strategic direction and enable engagement across preferred channels
Establish and maintain strategic governance and reporting across platforms, driving alignment between business objectives and technology delivery

Secondary Focus

Collaborate with AI team partners to integrate Actionable insights into the Advisor’s path into Client360 (and other Advisor platforms) for enabling pre-dive, post-dive and in the moment efficiencies and effectiveness
Lead rapid POC development cycles with authority to "fail fast / scale fast," designing multi-agent interactions across vendor agents, enterprise agents, and native/internal agents to AI-enable advisors through integration to the existing suite of technologies used by advisors
Act as Integrator to Client360 / Advisor Platform for agentic workflows—owning use case shaping through validated solution patterns, defining success metrics, and driving iteration based on advisor feedback and usage metrics

What Will You Do?

Establish and maintain strategic direction across CRM and Branch Platforms, ensuring consistency and alignment with advisor needs
Advocate on behalf of the advisor community in enterprise tool development and provide ongoing feedback loops
Develop business-centric programs and reporting that enhance daily advisor operations
Identify stakeholder needs, negotiate priorities across competing interests, and collaborate with developers/partners to implement requirements effectively
Keep business and technology stakeholders apprised of roadmap status and gather feedback
Deploy processes and technologies that safeguard Advisors and Clients (compliance and regulatory requirements)
Conduct advisor research and act as the voice of the Advisor community in platform development
Negotiate and prioritize enhancements to mitigate technical and financial risk
Partner with Technology, Procurement, and third-party vendors to execute strategic initiatives

What Do You Need to Succeed?

Must Have:

Deep Expertise in Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) Capabilities:

Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of Salesforce FSC platform architecture, features, and capabilities (e.g., financial account management, financial deals, wealth management, customer data platforms). The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience leveraging FSC to drive business outcomes, understand current and emerging FSC capabilities, and possess the ability to assess how these capabilities can inform and accelerate the evolution of Client360. This includes staying current with Salesforce product roadmaps and identifying opportunities to integrate new FSC innovations into Client360's strategic direction.

Business Strategy & Bridge from Strategy to Implementation

Exhibits strong strategic thinking combined with pragmatic execution capabilities. The candidate must be able to develop comprehensive business strategies aligned with organizational objectives while maintaining a keen understanding of implementation realities. This includes translating strategic visions into actionable roadmaps, managing stakeholder expectations, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and resource constraints, and ensuring accountability for delivery. Experience in leading cross-functional teams to execute complex transformation programs is essential.

Expert-Level Understanding of Client360 – Depth of Implemented Capabilities

Possesses deep, hands-on knowledge of Client360's current functionality, architecture, and implementations across diverse user groups and business units. The candidate should understand how different user personas leverage Client360, identify capability gaps, recognize overlaps, and articulate both strengths and limitations. This expertise enables informed decision-making about platform enhancements, feature prioritization, and strategic investments. The ability to draw on real-world implementation examples to validate strategy is critical.

Exceptional Executive Communication & Presentation Skills

Capable of distilling complex technical and strategic concepts into compelling, clear narratives for C-suite and board-level audiences. The ideal candidate can prepare polished executive presentations, develop strategic briefs, and communicate across diverse stakeholder groups with varying levels of technical sophistication. This includes strong data storytelling, ability to frame business cases persuasively, and the confidence to present recommendations with conviction while remaining open to feedback.

10+ years of progressive business experience (preferably in financial services or relevant line of business)
4+ years as a Product Manager or field experience within Regional Banking
Undergraduate degree in Business or related field

Nice-to-Have:

User Experience and Advisor research expertise
People management experience
Post-graduate degree in Business or MBA

What's In It For You?

Comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses, flexible benefits, and competitive compensation
Leaders who support your development through coaching and mentoring
Ability to drive meaningful, lasting impact across advisor and client experiences
Dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team environment
World-class training program in financial services
Opportunities to lead challenging, innovative initiatives

Job Skills

Commercial Acumen, Competitive Markets, Decision Making, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Financial Risk Management (FRM), Global Perspective, Long Term Planning, Managerial Courage, Risk Management

jobs.title: Program Director, Bell AI Fabric
jobs.description:
Req Id:
431516

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell’s AI Fabric initiative is pioneering a secure, sovereign AI compute network across Canada. This transformative portfolio includes seven large-scale, high-density data centres, anchored by a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2GW flagship site in Regina, Saskatchewan.

As Program Director, you will be accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the national data centre build program—orchestrating scope, schedule, budget, and cross-functional execution across multiple concurrent sites. You'll be the integrating force connecting construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls into one predictable, well-governed program, ensuring Bell delivers these mission-critical facilities on time, on budget, and to standard as the initiative scales aggressively nationally.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery accountability for the national data centre build program, integrating scope, schedule, budget, and quality across multiple concurrent sites.
Orchestrate cross-functional execution across construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls, ensuring alignment to program objectives.
Establish and govern the program delivery framework—stage gates, milestones, governance cadence, and decision rights—across the portfolio.
Own the integrated master schedule and program-level budget, driving predictability, transparency, and schedule discipline across all builds.
Lead program-level risk management, change governance, and interdependency management, escalating and resolving systemic issues before they impact delivery.
Provide executive-level program reporting to AI Fabric and Capital Programs leadership, translating complex delivery status into clear, decision-ready insight.
Manage program financials, forecasting, and capital planning in partnership with finance and program controls.
Drive resource planning and prioritization across sites, balancing competing demands as the program scales
Build and mature Bell's program delivery capability at a formative stage, embedding repeatable processes, playbooks, and lessons learned across the fleet.
Serve as a senior point of escalation and executive interface for site directors, functional leads, and external delivery partners.

Critical Qualifications

15+ years leading large-scale capital program delivery, with direct experience on hyperscale or mission-critical data centres (multi-site / multi-billion-dollar portfolios preferred)
Proven track record owning end-to-end program delivery across multiple concurrent construction projects, not just single-project management.
Deep command of program management disciplines—integrated master scheduling, budget/cost control, risk management, and change governance.
Strong understanding of the full data centre delivery lifecycle—construction, engineering, MEP, and commissioning through to operational handover.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and align diverse cross-functional teams and external delivery partners.
Expertise in program governance, stage-gate frameworks, and executive reporting.
Exceptional executive presence, able to influence and challenge senior engineering, construction, finance, and executive leaders.
Experience building and maturing a program delivery organization from a formative stage.
Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; PMP/PgMP, P.Eng., or equivalent strongly preferred.
Willingness to travel nationally between build locations as the portfolio scales.

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

Additional Information

Position Type:
Management

Job Status:
Regular - Full Time

Canada : Saskatchewan : Regina || Canada : Alberta : Calgary

We know that caring for our team members is at the heart of a healthy, positive and thriving workplace.
